text:
jye007@126.com
  
  
    
     Google Scholar
  
  
    
     ORCID
  

  
  
Jian Ye (Senior Member, IEEE) received the B.Eng. degree in electrical engineering and automation from Wuhan University, Wuhan, China, in 2012, and the M.Sc. and Ph.D. degrees in electrical engineering from Nanyang Technological University, Singapore, in 2013 and 2018, respectively. He is currently working at China Southern Power Grid (CSG) in Guangzhou, China. His research interests include intelligent control for power electronics and microgrids.



2026 - Present：China Southern Power Grid (CSG)
2019-2025: Assistant Professor/Associate Researcher, Harbin Institute of Technology, Shenzhen (HITSZ)
2018-2019：Research Fellow，Energy Research Institute @ NTU (ERI@N)
2014-2018: Ph.D. in Engineering, Nanyang Technological University, Singapore, specializing in Electrical Engineering
2012-2013: M.Sc. in Engineering, Nanyang Technological University, Singapore, specializing in Electrical Engineering
2008-2012: Bachelor of Engineering, Wuhan University, China, majoring in Electrical Engineering
